key_insight: LLM4EHR aligns ICU event sequences with time-series data using a domain-adapted LLM plus a transformer encoder to learn more transferable clinical representations.
clinical_relevance: The approach aims to improve downstream ICU prediction tasks by making EHR embeddings more robust across cohorts and easier to adapt with limited new data.
method: Pretrain a clinical foundation model on ICU EHR events and time series.
Use a domain-adapted large language model to embed medical event sequences.
Apply a regularized contrastive objective to temporally align event and time-series representations.
evidence_signal: In the abstract, the model is evaluated with ablation studies and downstream clinical tasks, and it reportedly improves performance while also showing k-shot transfer to new cohorts.
watch_item: The abstract does not provide external validation details or implementation constraints, so real-world generalization and deployment robustness still need careful confirmation.
paper_title: LLM4EHR: Aligning Clinical Time Series with Medical Event Sequences via Large Language Models
